# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**My top pick: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS names it the best ANC headphone under $200 it has tested. Its noise cancelling competes with Sony and Bose flagships, and the battery lasts about 60 hours. It supports multipoint, LDAC and LC3. The downsides are a high clamping force and mediocre headband padding, so it may be uncomfortable on a larger head. The price sometimes sits just under $200, so check it before buying. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200))

## Other good options

- **Best value: Soundcore Space One.** SoundGuys lists it at $100 with LDAC, adjustable ANC and about 43 hours of battery ([RatingMobile summary](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)). Dealectric lists it at $99.99, or $80 with code **AFSC20** (tested in the cart on 2026-10-22). [Buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). LDAC only helps on Android.
- **Best step-up from Soundcore: Soundcore Space One Pro.** Tom's Guide picks it as best under $200, and it has soft ear cups ([Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)). Dealectric lists it at $199.99, or $160 with **AFSC20**. [Buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro)
- **Cheapest decent ANC: Anker Soundcore Space Q45.** It's about $100 and RTINGS' best budget pick, with strong isolation and roughly 28 hours of battery. It has a faint hiss with ANC on, and some owners report headband or hinge breakage. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones))
- **Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus.** It has a smooth, bassy sound, a parametric EQ and 56 hours of battery. Its ANC is weaker than the JBL's or Anker's, and the headband is unpadded. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200))
- **Best for calls and strong ANC: Sony ULT WEAR (~$200).** RTINGS likes it for calls. SoundGuys measured the strongest low-frequency cancelling of its group and found it comfortable, with multipoint and LDAC. Its battery is shorter at about 32 hours. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200), [RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200))
- **Best for durability: CMF Headphone Pro.** It has stainless steel hinges and splash resistance. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones))
- **Sony WH-CH730N (~$176–178).** Tom's Guide praises its sound, ANC, comfort and battery, but says the US price feels high. ([Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review))

## Quick guide
- **Best all-round:** JBL Live 780NC
- **Tight budget:** Soundcore Space One, or the Q45
- **Sound quality:** Sennheiser Accentum Plus
- **Calls and commuting:** Sony ULT WEAR

## Notes
- The Dealectric links are affiliate links. They cost you nothing extra, but Dealectric earns a commission. The store's checkout has the final word on the code.
- The search results gave no direct purchase links for the JBL, Sony, Sennheiser, Q45 or CMF, so I linked their review pages. Those pages list Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and B&H.
- Prices change often, so compare before you buy. The Soundcore prices above come from the Dealectric listing (checked 2026-10-22). The SoundGuys prices are from March 2026, per RatingMobile, which did not test the headphones itself.

If you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android, and whether comfort or maximum ANC matters more, I can narrow this to one pick.
